_comment: Scope choices Guidestone made for the Chaffee Provides site. These are about what that site shows, not about the facts, so the Food Web keeps the records. include_categories is the allowlist (farms, farmers markets, makers); exclude_categories drops a record whose categories are all listed; exclude_slugs and hide_pin_slugs are per producer.

exclude_slugs.cottonwood-spirit-ranch: Not applicable for now: mostly a vacation rental that sells beef to guests (Alycen Quattrocchi, Oct 13 2026)

exclude_categories.Agritourism: Guidestone does not want agritourism on the Chaffee Provides site (user, 2026-10-15)
exclude_categories.Bakery: Bakeries are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (user, 2026-10-15)
exclude_categories.Restaurant: Restaurants are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (JP provider, 2026-10-15)
exclude_categories.Caterer: Caterers are not part of the Chaffee Provides set (JP provider, 2026-10-15)

hide_pin_slugs.everett-ranch-beef: Social media only; listed so people can message them, but not shown on the map (user, 2026-10-15)

include_categories.On-Farm / Ranch Sales: Part of the Chaffee Provides set
include_categories.Roadside Market: Part of the Chaffee Provides set
include_categories.U-Pick: Part of the Chaffee Provides set
include_categories.CSA Farm: Part of the Chaffee Provides set

include_categories.Specialty Shop: Part of the Chaffee Provides set: herb, seed and farm shops (user, 2026-10-15)
